notes.title: Why I Spent 4,500 Hours Making an Anti-Capitalist Game?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858394/69daa1d78647242384ad2fc56ef6091b2d84b9f9.png[/img]

Friends, my indie game Devil Corporation: Onboarding has officially launched on Steam today.

Its most defining feature is undoubtedly its theme of "workers versus capitalists."
Throughout development, I’ve been repeatedly cautioned to "stay positive," "consider the bigger picture," and "stop preaching about things you don’t understand"—after all, I’m just a corporate drone with over a decade of grind, oblivious to the hardships of business owners.

To these well-intentioned reminders, my response is: You own a computer too. Feel free to make "big-picture" games or write stories about the struggles of CEOs.
My experiences have shaped my perspective—this is the energy life has given me. To others, it might seem worthless, but to me, it’s the nutrients that have nourished Devil Corporation: Onboarding.

Of course, as my first solo-developed game, it’s far from polished—in fact, it’s deeply imperfect.
Despite working in game studios for over a decade, this is my unprecedented attempt at handling everything alone: code learned from scratch, art cobbled together through community support and friends’ generosity, and design forged through iterative trial-and-error.

With the launch, I’m overwhelmed with reflections and want to pour out the lessons learned on this journey. Let’s grow together!

notes.title: 35+ Office-themed ‘Adult’ RPG Demo Available Now During Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Demon Corporation: Onboarding joins Steam Next Fest starting next Monday, Feb 24th! The early access demo is now live – dive into the first two chapters of this corporate hellscape RPG developed entirely by solo dev studio A Shrine of Ludens. Crunch the numbers, break the system, and join the rebellion early!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858394/f8fed8fb8210a638c9045565ebbd4530e03b0c1f.png[/img]

[u][b]Developer Story[/b][/u]
Crafted single-handedly by a former triple-A studio veteran (code/music/art), Demon Corporation: Onboarding transforms real office trauma into pixelated therapy. Any resemblance to real-life companies is purely... accurate.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858394/ed612f8c6229cecd831061b2f96d726865ec3c6c.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Gameplay Breakdown[/b][/u]
This pixel-art tactical RPG blends:
✓ Magic Tower-style strategic combat
✓ Persona-esque social link system
✓ Roguelite office floor generation
✓ Match-3 performance review minigames
✓ Escape room-style corporate espionage puzzles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858394/6cdc26899d4b36419e4c70538fd19d3e265ed424.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Corporate Fantasy Plot[/b][/u]
Play as Mei - a rookie programmer trapped in Tokyo's most toxic tech sweatshop. 
By day: code-monkeying through soul-crushing KPIs. 
By night: become the "Corporate Avenger" in a supernatural snack-fueled shadow realm. 
Uncover dark secrets with your oppressed coworkers-turned-rebels to overthrow the C-suite demons!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858394/9bc5d9995edfb701a60253b7d44298642b9a17fd.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Next Fest Demo Highlights[/b][/u]
1️⃣ Expanded main storyline exposing corporate hellscapes
2️⃣ 10+ new side quests to "optimize" your workplace
3️⃣ Full EN/CN localization - let overseas players taste the 996 life

Whether you're surviving daily standups or pre-gaming your career, this dark comedy RPG delivers:
➔ Office veterans: Finally Ctrl+Alt+Delete your boss
➔ Future workforce: Learn corporate survival tactics early

Set your out-of-office reminder - the corporate revolution begins February 24th. See you in the (virtual) trenches!
